toy_model_M.description: Faithful finite stand-in for the kinetic->hydro pair. Carrier Z = single-particle distribution f(v) on a FINITE 1D velocity grid in a single spatial cell (the standard local Chapman-Enskog cell); a state is a nonnegative weight vector over Nv discrete velocities. This is a minimal faithful finite stand-in, not reverse-engineered from a desired Xi.
toy_model_M.lens_f_target_native_probe_L0: Hydrodynamics keeps the low-order CONSERVED velocity moments: m0=sum_k f_k (mass/number density), m1=sum_k v_k f_k (momentum density), m2=sum_k v_k^2 f_k (energy density). L0 = the 3xNv matrix of these moment rows -- exactly the slow/conserved fields hydrodynamics carries.
toy_model_M.dissolving_source_probe_D0: Two declared orientations: (A) D0 = the conserved/Euler-level hydrodynamic readouts the hydro EQUATIONS are built from (mass, momentum, energy, and a conserved-flux combination), all in span{1,v,v^2}; (B) D0 ALSO includes genuinely kinetic non-slow readouts (v^3 heat-flux moment, v^4-1.5 v^2 stress/Burnett shape) NOT in span{1,v,v^2}, which carry the transport-coefficient VALUES.
toy_model_M.audit_energy_C0: Inverse-equilibrium (Maxwellian) diagonal weighting on the velocity-cell carrier -- the natural local-equilibrium/collision metric; strictly PSD.
toy_model_M.refinement_chain: Nv = 7 (h1) < 15 (h2) < 31 (h3): three declared finite refinements (gate E.9).
toy_model_M.toy_to_accepted_observables_map: Orientation-(A) descended content = density/velocity/pressure/temperature fields, sound speed, dispersion -- ALL in hydrodynamics.accepted_observables (no over-read, gate E.3). Orientation-(B) extra readouts = transport coefficients / mean free path / relaxation times / H-function = SOURCE-only kinetic observables, correctly NOT descended.

Exact-adequacy theorem: the conserved-moment / constitutive FORM of hydrodynamics factors cleanly through the kinetic slow-moment lens. Refinement-stable (gate E.9 PASS: verdict does not flip).
